document.title: Phase 3: XQuery 4.0 and serialization
document.p: Goal (PLAN.md): XQuery 4.0 (FLWOR, constructors, prolog, modules) and serialization, lowered into the shared IR () and run by the one evaluator; sxml xquery and sxml serialize (docs/CLI.md). Gate: 85% of the applicable XQ40 test cases pass, 75% of the XQ-only ones (). Rules for parallel packets are those of docs/tasks/phase-2.md (, ).

section.title: Overlap with Phase 2 ()
section.p: Packets marked Early may start as soon as the Phase 1 gate is closed (the substrate freeze) and their "After" list is committed, while Phase 2 is still running; the Phase 2 file shows the waves they join. They own no file of a Phase 2 packet. The other packets wait for the Phase 2 gate. Early: 3.0, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9.

section.title: How XQuery lowers (, src/ir_internal.h)
section.p: One AST holds XPath and XQuery kinds (3.1). Lowering parts (2.1) add the XQuery kinds in their own files: FLWOR clauses to MAP, LET, CONDITIONAL and SORT over tuple arrays; group by and windows to internal native rows; constructors to the reserved constructor kinds; try/catch to TRY_CATCH; typeswitch and switch to CONDITIONAL chains; prolog functions to IR functions, prolog variables to globals with initializers; library modules into the same unit. The evaluator runs the reserved kinds in the stub files of 2.0. Nothing here adds an IR kind; a packet that needs one stops and writes the reason under "Proposed".
